entries.080a6a730dbc3708: It holds production technology in-house and has the capability to respond to high-mix, variable-volume production, and is also expanding improvement activities under its proprietary integrated management system "∫IΣS (SIMS)" beyond production to development, sales and logistics. In capacitors and modules, it is advancing technology development centered on thinner films and higher withstand voltage, and on improving service life performance and environmental resistance performance. Another feature is that the group holds within itself the technologies of both capacitors, its core devices, and the power electronics equipment that puts them to use.

entries.11d9337a2fb0ef69: Toward realizing its long-term management vision (fiscal 2019 to fiscal 2028), the company is promoting Phase III of its medium-term management plan (fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2028) under the theme "From fusion to synergy, toward improving corporate value." The basic policy of Phase III is to promote, in an integrated manner, optimization of its business portfolio, strengthening of earning power, productivity reform, and improvement of capital efficiency. It states that it will strengthen coordination among businesses centered on capacitor products, and advance the creation of solutions fusing the technologies of both capacitors, its core devices, and power electronics equipment.

entries.382f08f0eb1be236: It is an electronic components and power equipment manufacturer headquartered in Nishinomiya City, Hyogo Prefecture, with film capacitors at its core. The company sells products under the 'SHIZUKI' brand. The company operates together with 7 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 equity-method affiliate, and the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 1,166. The company is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
entries.3b26c50970496328: This business manufactures and sells power equipment systems, including power factor correction equipment, harmonic suppression equipment, instantaneous voltage drop compensation equipment, railway feeding equipment and DC-DC converters integrated with energy storage. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,196 million. In addition to the company's own manufacturing and sales, consolidated subsidiary Kyūshū Shizuki Kabushiki Kaisha manufactures products, all of which the company purchases and sells. Shizuki Tekuno Sābisu Kabushiki Kaisha also belongs to this business. Shizuki Shishiki (Shanghai) Bōeki Yūgen Kōshi handles sales of some of the company's products in the Chinese market, and Thai Shizuki Denki Kabushiki Kaisha handles manufacturing and sales in the Thai market.
